title: Multi-layer X-ray lens over OpenStreetMap
blurb: A draggable circular WebGL 2 shader lens over live OpenStreetMap tiles that reveals a dark night, thermal density or blueprint edge layer underneath, plus interactive HTML neighbourhood cards clipped to the lens aperture.
question: Can a draggable circular shader lens over an OpenStreetMap street map reveal a second map style underneath (dark night, thermal density, or edge-detected contour view) along with live interactive HTML neighbourhood cards that only appear inside the lens?
result: Built on one ElementGL WebGL 2 context compositing OpenStreetMap daytime tiles, CARTO DarkMatter night tiles, thermal and Sobel blueprint shaders, and circularly clipped drawable HTML cards synced with canvasClip and inert. Live browser verification is not run yet.
